reply.text:
This is a body-related symptom ("achy shoulders"), so I won't assess it or suggest anything to work around it. That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach.

What I can do is keep your training going on the side you're able to use. Tell me which movements to leave out, and I'll make sure any build I give you keeps overhead pressing and pull-ups off the table. Do you want me to hand the program side over to the app now?
